meta.title: Noavaran Zibayi | Skin, Hair & Laser Clinic
meta.description: Noavaran Zibayi — natural beauty through a scientific approach and precise skin, hair, and laser care.

bullets: Support until you reach your results

slides.title: Natural Hair Transplant With Lasting, Believable Results
slides.subtitle: Achieve a natural hairline and the density you want with advanced transplant techniques — we're with you from consultation through aftercare.

slides.title: Carboxytherapy — the Secret to Radiant, Energized Skin
slides.subtitle: Controlled CO2 injections stimulate skin circulation, leaving your complexion brighter and more youthful.

slides.title: Microneedling for Smooth, Even Skin
slides.subtitle: By triggering the skin's natural collagen production, we minimize enlarged pores, acne scars, and fine lines.

slides.title: Body Contouring With Liposmatic & Abdominal Surgery
slides.subtitle: Remove stubborn localized fat safely and with minimal invasiveness to achieve a more balanced silhouette.

slides.title: Rhinoplasty, in Harmony With Your Face
slides.subtitle: A nose design tailored to your facial structure, performed by an experienced cosmetic surgery team.

slides.title: Hair & Beard Transplant for a Cohesive, Masculine Look
slides.subtitle: Experience natural density and lasting results with today's hair and beard transplant techniques.

slides.title: Skin Rejuvenation With the Latest Global Methods
slides.subtitle: Reduce wrinkles and sagging, and restore the glow and freshness of youthful skin.

slides.title: Targeted & General Weight Loss, Done Right
slides.subtitle: Reach your ideal body shape with specialized weight-loss programs built to last.

slides.title: Mesotherapy — Deep Nourishment for Skin & Hair
slides.subtitle: Micronutrient injections into the skin's deeper layers boost the health and radiance of your skin and hair.

slides.title: Abdominoplasty for a Flat, Firm Stomach
slides.subtitle: Correct excess skin and loosened abdominal muscles with specialized surgery.

slides.title: Laser Hair Removal — Lasting and Pain-Free
slides.subtitle: With state-of-the-art laser devices, enjoy smooth, hair-free skin for the long term.

slides.title: Cosmetic Surgery to International Standards
slides.subtitle: Our experienced surgical team performs a full range of cosmetic procedures with precision and safety.

slides.title: Face Lift — a Youthful Look Without Heavy Surgery
slides.subtitle: Correct facial sagging and enjoy a fresher, more lifted appearance.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions from our clients

items.q: How do I book an appointment?
items.a: You can book a consultation or a specific service through our booking page or by calling us directly.

items.q: Do I need a consultation before every service?
items.a: Yes, we recommend a consultation first so we can design the right treatment plan for you.

items.q: How much do the services cost?
items.a: Pricing depends on the service and your specific needs, and is explained clearly during your consultation.

items.q: What aftercare is needed following treatment?
items.a: Our team provides a personalized aftercare guide and follows up on your recovery.

items.q: Can I reschedule or cancel my appointment?
items.a: Yes, just contact us before your appointment time and we'll reschedule or cancel it for you.
